cond_0001.intro: Registered Client Service Associates (CSAs) help shape the future of service by modernizing the client experience through an elevated standard of care. The Registered CSA assists with the development and growth of business through engaging and utilizing the full capabilities of the firm. This is a key role that requires an understanding of firm policies, procedures and firm capabilities in order to deliver the full firm to clients.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
CLIENT SUPPORT
Cultivate and enhance new and existing client relationships through active communication with clients, processing client requests, resolving inquiries, providing guidance and making sure key information and documentation remains current
Identify and assist with Firm services and solutions that support clients' needs including banking products and services and secure, digital offerings like [Product name masked] and [Product name masked]
Confirm authorization and authenticate client when processing requests
Onboard and maintain client accounts, including collecting client information and required documentation, capturing and assessing risk, processing money movement transactions and handling estate needs as examples
Input orders at the direction of clients and/or Financial Advisor(s), discuss reinvestment options and corporate actions with clients at the direction of Financial Advisors
Prepare financial plans, client reports, and other materials for client meetings
Review and take appropriate action on client account alerts
OTHER
Partner with Financial Advisor(s) in developing a business plan and delivering against a client service model
Support the team's marketing strategy by maintaining marketing materials, including digital and social media platforms, and planning client events and seminars
Actively engage in available training and education programs - including firm strategic priorities, professional development and staying current on policies, procedures and new platforms and attend scheduled targeted/monthly field service professional and/or training calls
Perform administrative duties that support Financial Advisors in daily business practices, including but not limited to, telephone coverage, business travel arrangements, coordination of client meetings, prepare travel & expense reports, and file & calendar maintenance
Proactively participate in firm initiatives directed by local management
Regularly seek opportunities to use firm resources for peer sharing and collaborating with Financial Advisors
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Active Series 7 (GS), and Series 66 (AG/RA) or Series 63 (AG) and Series 65 (RA)
High School Diploma/Equivalency
Strong industry, product, and branch procedures knowledge
Exceptional writing, interpersonal and client service skills
Detail oriented with superior organizational skills and ability to prioritize tasks
Strong computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office products
Team player with the ability to collaborate with others
Knowledge of financial services products, including but not limited to equities, bonds, options, mutual funds, annuities, insurance, and managed accounts
Preferred Requirements
Two or more years of industry experience
College degree
Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment
Goal oriented, self-motivated and results driven
Reports To: Business Service Officer

cond_0019.intro: Registered Client Service Associates (CSAs) help shape the future of service by modernizing the client experience through an elevated standard of care. The Registered CSA assists with the development and growth of business through engaging and utilizing the full capabilities of the firm. This is a key role that requires an understanding of firm policies, procedures and firm capabilities in order to deliver the full firm to clients.
cond_0019.responsibilities:
CLIENT SUPPORT
Cultivate and enhance new and existing client relationships through active communication with clients, processing client requests, resolving inquiries, providing guidance and making sure key information and documentation remains current
Identify and assist with Firm services and solutions that support clients' needs including banking products and services and secure, digital offerings like [Product name masked] and [Product name masked]
Confirm authorization and authenticate client when processing requests
Onboard and maintain client accounts, including collecting client information and required documentation, capturing and assessing risk, processing money movement transactions and handling estate needs as examples
Input orders at the direction of clients and/or Financial Advisor(s), discuss reinvestment options and corporate actions with clients at the direction of Financial Advisors
Prepare financial plans, client reports, and other materials for client meetings
Review and take appropriate action on client account alerts
OTHER
Partner with Financial Advisor(s) in developing a business plan and delivering against a client service model
Support the team's marketing strategy by maintaining marketing materials, including digital and social media platforms, and planning client events and seminars
Actively engage in available training and education programs - including firm strategic priorities, professional development and staying current on policies, procedures and new platforms and attend scheduled targeted/monthly field service professional and/or training calls
Perform administrative duties that support Financial Advisors in daily business practices, including but not limited to, telephone coverage, business travel arrangements, coordination of client meetings, prepare travel & expense reports, and file & calendar maintenance
Proactively participate in firm initiatives directed by local management
Regularly seek opportunities to use firm resources for peer sharing and collaborating with Financial Advisors
cond_0019.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Active Series 7 (GS), and Series 66 (AG/RA) or Series 63 (AG) and Series 65 (RA)
High School Diploma/Equivalency
Strong industry, product, and branch procedures knowledge
Exceptional writing, interpersonal and client service skills
Detail oriented with superior organizational skills and ability to prioritize tasks
Strong computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office products
Team player with the ability to collaborate with others
Knowledge of financial services products, including but not limited to equities, bonds, options, mutual funds, annuities, insurance, and managed accounts
Preferred Requirements
Two or more years of industry experience
College degree
Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment
Goal oriented, self-motivated and results driven
Reports To: Business Service Officer

CLIENT SUPPORT

Identify and assist with Firm services and solutions that support clients' needs including banking products and services and secure, digital offerings like [Product name masked] and [Product name masked]

Regularly seek opportunities to use firm resources for peer sharing and collaborating with Financial Advisors

Detail oriented with superior organizational skills and ability to prioritize tasks

Team player with the ability to collaborate with others
Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment

CLIENT SUPPORT
Cultivate and enhance new and existing client relationships through active communication with clients, processing client requests, resolving inquiries, providing guidance and making sure key information and documentation remains current
Identify and assist with Firm services and solutions that support clients' needs including banking products and services and secure, digital offerings like [Product name masked] and [Product name masked]
Confirm authorization and authenticate client when processing requests
Onboard and maintain client accounts, including collecting client information and required documentation, capturing and assessing risk, processing money movement transactions and handling estate needs as examples

Prepare financial plans, client reports, and other materials for client meetings
Review and take appropriate action on client account alerts
OTHER
Partner with Financial Advisor(s) in developing a business plan and delivering against a client service model

Perform administrative duties that support Financial Advisors in daily business practices, including but not limited to, telephone coverage, business travel arrangements, coordination of client meetings, prepare travel & expense reports, and file & calendar maintenance
Proactively participate in firm initiatives directed by local management
Regularly seek opportunities to use firm resources for peer sharing and collaborating with Financial Advisors
cond_0055.requirements:

High School Diploma/Equivalency

Detail oriented with superior organizational skills and ability to prioritize tasks
Strong computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office products
Team player with the ability to collaborate with others
Knowledge of financial services products, including but not limited to equities, bonds, options, mutual funds, annuities, insurance, and managed accounts

College degree

cond_0153.intro: Registered Client Service Associates (CSAs) help shape the future of service by modernizing the client experience through an elevated standard of care. CLIENT SUPPORT
Coordinate with clients to cultivate and enhance new and existing relationships through active communication, processing client requests, resolving inquiries, providing guidance, and making sure key information and documentation remains current

Confirm authorization and authenticate client when processing requests
Work with the team to onboard and maintain client accounts, including collecting client information and required documentation, capturing and assessing risk, processing money movement transactions, and handling estate needs as examples

Prepare financial plans, client reports, and other materials for client meetings
Review and take appropriate action on client account alerts
OTHER
Partner with Financial Advisor(s) in developing a business plan and delivering against a client service model
Support the team's marketing strategy by maintaining marketing materials, including digital and social media platforms, and coordinating client events and seminars
Actively engage in available training and education programs - including firm strategic priorities, professional development, and staying current on policies, procedures, and new platforms, and attend scheduled targeted/monthly field service professional and/or training calls
Assist Financial Advisors with administrative duties in daily business practices, including but not limited to telephone coverage, business travel arrangements, coordination of client meetings, preparing travel and expense reports, and file and calendar maintenance
Proactively participate in firm initiatives directed by local management
Regularly seek opportunities to use firm resources for peer sharing and collaborating with Financial Advisors
cond_0153.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Active Series 7 (GS), and Series 66 (AG/RA) or Series 63 (AG) and Series 65 (RA)
High School Diploma/Equivalency
Strong industry, product, and branch procedures knowledge
Exceptional writing, interpersonal, and client service skills
Detail oriented with superior organizational skills and ability to prioritize tasks
Strong computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office products
Ability to work as part of a team and collaborate with others
Preferred Requirements
Two or more years of industry experience
College degree
Knowledge of financial services products, including but not limited to equities, bonds, options, mutual funds, annuities, insurance, and managed accounts
Goal oriented, self-motivated, and results driven
Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment

This role requires an understanding of firm policies, procedures, and firm capabilities in order to deliver the full firm to clients.
cond_0225.responsibilities:
CLIENT SUPPORT
Coordinate with clients to cultivate and enhance new and existing relationships through active communication, processing client requests, resolving inquiries, providing guidance, and making sure key information and documentation remains current
Help identify and connect clients with firm services and solutions that support their needs, including banking products and services and secure, digital offerings like [Product name masked] and [Product name masked]
Confirm authorization and authenticate client when processing requests
Work with the team to onboard and maintain client accounts, including collecting client information and required documentation, capturing and assessing risk, processing money movement transactions, and handling estate needs as examples
Input orders at the direction of clients and/or Financial Advisor(s), and share reinvestment options and corporate actions with clients at the direction of Financial Advisors
Prepare financial plans, client reports, and other materials for client meetings
Review and take appropriate action on client account alerts
OTHER
Partner with Financial Advisor(s) in developing a business plan and delivering against a client service model
Support the team's marketing strategy by maintaining marketing materials, including digital and social media platforms, and coordinating client events and seminars
Actively engage in available training and education programs - including firm strategic priorities, professional development, and staying current on policies, procedures, and new platforms, and attend scheduled targeted/monthly field service professional and/or training calls
Assist Financial Advisors with administrative duties in daily business practices, including but not limited to telephone coverage, business travel arrangements, coordination of client meetings, preparing travel and expense reports, and file and calendar maintenance
Proactively participate in firm initiatives directed by local management
Regularly seek opportunities to use firm resources for peer sharing and collaborating with Financial Advisors
cond_0225.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Active Series 7 (GS), and Series 66 (AG/RA) or Series 63 (AG) and Series 65 (RA)
High School Diploma/Equivalency
Strong industry, product, and branch procedures knowledge
Exceptional writing, interpersonal, and client service skills
Detail oriented with superior organizational skills and ability to prioritize tasks
Strong computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office products
Ability to work as part of a team and collaborate with others
Preferred Requirements
Two or more years of industry experience
College degree
Knowledge of financial services products, including but not limited to equities, bonds, options, mutual funds, annuities, insurance, and managed accounts
Goal oriented, self-motivated, and results driven
Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment
cond_0225.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0225.values: We value achievement and a strong commitment to quality in what we deliver. We aim to set high standards and meet them consistently.

The Registered CSA works alongside colleagues to support the development and growth of business by engaging and utilizing the full capabilities of the firm. This role requires an understanding of firm policies, procedures and firm capabilities in order to deliver the full firm to clients.
cond_0234.responsibilities:
CLIENT SUPPORT
Coordinate with clients to cultivate and enhance new and existing relationships through active communication, processing client requests, resolving inquiries, providing guidance and making sure key information and documentation remains current
Help identify and connect clients with firm services and solutions that support their needs including banking products and services and secure, digital offerings like [Product name masked] and [Product name masked]
Confirm authorization and authenticate client when processing requests
Work with the team to onboard and maintain client accounts, including collecting client information and required documentation, capturing and assessing risk, processing money movement transactions and handling estate needs as examples
Input orders at the direction of clients and/or Financial Advisor(s), and coordinate with clients on reinvestment options and corporate actions at the direction of Financial Advisors
Prepare financial plans, client reports, and other materials for client meetings
Review and take appropriate action on client account alerts
OTHER
Partner with Financial Advisor(s) in developing a business plan and delivering against a client service model
Support the team's marketing strategy by maintaining marketing materials, including digital and social media platforms, and coordinating client events and seminars
Actively engage in available training and education programs - including firm strategic priorities, professional development and staying current on policies, procedures and new platforms and attend scheduled targeted/monthly field service professional and/or training calls
Assist Financial Advisors with administrative duties in daily business practices, including but not limited to, telephone coverage, business travel arrangements, coordination of client meetings, prepare travel & expense reports, and file & calendar maintenance
Proactively participate in firm initiatives directed by local management
Regularly seek opportunities to use firm resources for peer sharing and collaborating with Financial Advisors
cond_0234.requirements:
Active Series 7 (GS), and Series 66 (AG/RA) or Series 63 (AG) and Series 65 (RA)
Two or more years of industry experience preferred
High School Diploma/Equivalency
College degree preferred
Strong industry, product, and branch procedures knowledge
Exceptional writing, interpersonal and client service skills
Detail oriented with superior organizational skills and ability to prioritize tasks
Strong computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office products
Team player with the ability to collaborate with others
Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment
Goal oriented, self-motivated and results driven
Knowledge of financial services products, including but not limited to equities, bonds, options, mutual funds, annuities, insurance, and managed accounts
Reports To: Business Service Officer

This is a key role that requires an understanding of firm policies, procedures and firm capabilities in order to deliver the full firm to clients.
cond_0280.responsibilities:
CLIENT SUPPORT
Cultivate and enhance new and existing client relationships through active communication with clients, processing client requests, resolving inquiries, providing guidance and making sure key information and documentation remains current
Identify and assist with Firm services and solutions that support clients' needs including banking products and services and secure, digital offerings like [Product name masked] and [Product name masked]
Confirm authorization and authenticate client when processing requests
Onboard and maintain client accounts, including collecting client information and required documentation, capturing and assessing risk, processing money movement transactions and handling estate needs as examples
Input orders at the direction of clients and/or Financial Advisor(s), discuss reinvestment options and corporate actions with clients at the direction of Financial Advisors
Prepare financial plans, client reports, and other materials for client meetings
Review and take appropriate action on client account alerts
OTHER
Partner with Financial Advisor(s) in developing a business plan and delivering against a client service model

Actively engage in available training and education programs - including firm strategic priorities, professional development and staying current on policies, procedures and new platforms and attend scheduled targeted/monthly field service professional and/or training calls
Perform administrative duties that support Financial Advisors in daily business practices, including but not limited to, telephone coverage, business travel arrangements, coordination of client meetings, prepare travel & expense reports, and file & calendar maintenance
Proactively participate in firm initiatives directed by local management
Regularly seek opportunities to use firm resources for peer sharing and collaborating with Financial Advisors
cond_0280.requirements:
Active Series 7 (GS), and Series 66 (AG/RA) or Series 63 (AG) and Series 65 (RA)
Two or more years of industry experience preferred
High School Diploma/Equivalency
College degree preferred
Strong industry, product, and branch procedures knowledge
Exceptional writing, interpersonal and client service skills
Detail oriented with superior organizational skills and ability to prioritize tasks
Strong computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office products
Team player with the ability to collaborate with others

The Registered CSA assists with the development and growth of business through actively engaging clients and utilizing the full capabilities of the firm. This role requires a solid understanding of firm policies, procedures, and capabilities in order to deliver the full firm to clients — and a large part of the day involves direct, ongoing communication with clients and colleagues.
cond_0321.responsibilities:
CLIENT SUPPORT
Cultivate and enhance new and existing client relationships through regular, active communication with clients, processing client requests, resolving inquiries, providing guidance, and making sure key information and documentation remains current
Identify and assist with Firm services and solutions that support clients' needs including banking products and services and secure, digital offerings like [Product name masked] and [Product name masked]
Confirm authorization and authenticate client when processing requests
Onboard and maintain client accounts, including collecting client information and required documentation, capturing and assessing risk, processing money movement transactions, and handling estate needs as examples
Input orders at the direction of clients and/or Financial Advisor(s), discuss reinvestment options and corporate actions with clients at the direction of Financial Advisors
Prepare financial plans, client reports, and other materials for client meetings
Review and take appropriate action on client account alerts
OTHER
Partner closely with Financial Advisor(s) in developing a business plan and delivering against a client service model
Support the team's marketing strategy by maintaining marketing materials, including digital and social media platforms, and planning client events and seminars
Actively engage in available training and education programs — including firm strategic priorities, professional development, and staying current on policies, procedures, and new platforms — and attend scheduled targeted/monthly field service professional and/or training calls
Perform administrative duties that support Financial Advisors in daily business practices, including but not limited to telephone coverage, business travel arrangements, coordination of client meetings, preparing travel and expense reports, and file and calendar maintenance
Proactively participate in firm initiatives directed by local management
Regularly seek opportunities to use firm resources for peer sharing and collaborating with Financial Advisors
cond_0321.requirements:
Active Series 7 (GS), and Series 66 (AG/RA) or Series 63 (AG) and Series 65 (RA)
Two or more years of industry experience preferred
High School Diploma/Equivalency
College degree preferred
Strong industry, product, and branch procedures knowledge
Exceptional writing, interpersonal, and client service skills
Detail oriented with superior organizational skills and ability to prioritize tasks
Strong computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office products
Team player with the ability to collaborate with others
Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment
Goal oriented, self-motivated, and results driven
Knowledge of financial services products, including but not limited to equities, bonds, options, mutual funds, annuities, insurance, and managed accounts
cond_0321.values: We value achievement and a strong commitment to quality in what we deliver. We aim to set high standards and meet them consistently.
cond_0321.workplace_support: We know there is no one-size-fits-all approach to work. That is why we support flexibility while also creating opportunities for people to connect, build community, and feel a sense of belonging at work.

cond_0564.intro: Registered Client Service Associates (CSAs) help shape the future of service by modernizing the client experience through an elevated standard of care. The Registered CSA assists with the development and growth of business through actively engaging clients and utilizing the full capabilities of the firm. This role requires a solid understanding of firm policies, procedures, and capabilities in order to deliver the full firm to clients — and a large part of the day involves direct, ongoing communication with clients and colleagues.
cond_0564.responsibilities:
CLIENT SUPPORT
Cultivate and enhance new and existing client relationships through regular, active communication with clients, processing client requests, resolving inquiries, providing guidance, and making sure key information and documentation remains current
Identify and assist with Firm services and solutions that support clients' needs including banking products and services and secure, digital offerings like [Product name masked] and [Product name masked]
Confirm authorization and authenticate client when processing requests
Onboard and maintain client accounts, including collecting client information and required documentation, capturing and assessing risk, processing money movement transactions, and handling estate needs as examples
Input orders at the direction of clients and/or Financial Advisor(s), discuss reinvestment options and corporate actions with clients at the direction of Financial Advisors
Prepare financial plans, client reports, and other materials for client meetings
Review and take appropriate action on client account alerts
OTHER
Partner closely with Financial Advisor(s) in developing a business plan and delivering against a client service model
Support the team's marketing strategy by maintaining marketing materials, including digital and social media platforms, and planning client events and seminars
Actively engage in available training and education programs — including firm strategic priorities, professional development, and staying current on policies, procedures, and new platforms — and attend scheduled targeted/monthly field service professional and/or training calls
Perform administrative duties that support Financial Advisors in daily business practices, including but not limited to telephone coverage, business travel arrangements, coordination of client meetings, preparing travel and expense reports, and file and calendar maintenance
Proactively participate in firm initiatives directed by local management
Regularly seek opportunities to use firm resources for peer sharing and collaborating with Financial Advisors
cond_0564.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Active Series 7 (GS), and Series 66 (AG/RA) or Series 63 (AG) and Series 65 (RA)
High School Diploma/Equivalency
Strong industry, product, and branch procedures knowledge
Exceptional writing, interpersonal, and client service skills — you will be in regular contact with clients and colleagues throughout the day
Detail oriented with superior organizational skills and ability to prioritize tasks
Strong computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office products
Ability to work in a busy, evolving environment
Preferred Requirements
Two or more years of industry experience
College degree
Knowledge of financial services products, including but not limited to equities, bonds, options, mutual funds, annuities, insurance, and managed accounts
Team player with the ability to collaborate with others and initiate peer sharing
Goal oriented, self-motivated, and results driven

This role requires a solid understanding of firm policies, procedures, and capabilities in order to deliver the full firm to clients — and a large part of the day involves direct, ongoing communication with clients and colleagues.
cond_0627.responsibilities:
CLIENT SUPPORT
Cultivate and enhance new and existing client relationships through regular, active communication with clients, processing client requests, resolving inquiries, providing guidance, and making sure key information and documentation remains current
Identify and assist with Firm services and solutions that support clients' needs including banking products and services and secure, digital offerings like [Product name masked] and [Product name masked]
Confirm authorization and authenticate client when processing requests
Onboard and maintain client accounts, including collecting client information and required documentation, capturing and assessing risk, processing money movement transactions, and handling estate needs as examples
Input orders at the direction of clients and/or Financial Advisor(s), discuss reinvestment options and corporate actions with clients at the direction of Financial Advisors
Prepare financial plans, client reports, and other materials for client meetings
Review and take appropriate action on client account alerts
OTHER
Partner closely with Financial Advisor(s) in developing a business plan and delivering against a client service model
Support the team's marketing strategy by maintaining marketing materials, including digital and social media platforms, and planning client events and seminars
Actively engage in available training and education programs — including firm strategic priorities, professional development, and staying current on policies, procedures, and new platforms — and attend scheduled targeted/monthly field service professional and/or training calls
Perform administrative duties that support Financial Advisors in daily business practices, including but not limited to telephone coverage, business travel arrangements, coordination of client meetings, preparing travel and expense reports, and file and calendar maintenance
Proactively participate in firm initiatives directed by local management
Regularly seek opportunities to use firm resources for peer sharing and collaborating with Financial Advisors
cond_0627.requirements:
Active Series 7 (GS), and Series 66 (AG/RA) or Series 63 (AG) and Series 65 (RA)
Two or more years of industry experience preferred
High School Diploma/Equivalency
College degree preferred
Strong industry, product, and branch procedures knowledge
Exceptional writing, interpersonal, and client service skills
Detail oriented with superior organizational skills and ability to prioritize tasks
Strong computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office products
Team player with the ability to collaborate with others
Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment
Goal oriented, self-motivated, and results driven
Knowledge of financial services products, including but not limited to equities, bonds, options, mutual funds, annuities, insurance, and managed accounts
cond_0627.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
